Upgrade codemods up to 0.420.0 removed
detail: Every app is past 0.420.0, so the upgrade codemods of earlier releases are gone from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-feature-ast (src/scripts/codemod), among them package-merge, feature-factory, s3-imports, migrate-db-raw, migrate-cross-tenant, migrate-open-to-all, object-form, db-factory, tenant-db-options, testing-move, testing-injection, ctx-namespaces, pii-personal-migration and scaffold-kms-mode. import-extensions and feature-layout, the two codemods a guard points to, stay next to the upgrade codemods of later releases, and `kumiko codemod` lists those two; feature-layout was missing from that list, so the hint of the app-feature-structure guard failed.
migration: An app whose .kumiko/upgrade-state.json is below 0.420.0 first runs `kumiko-upgrade --apply` with a framework release up to 0.420.0, then upgrades to this one.

title: Handbook chapter links resolve on static hosting
kumiko check fails when biome.json does not extend the Kumiko Biome preset
detail: The lint step now reads `biome.json` or `biome.jsonc` (comments allowed) before it starts Biome and follows relative `extends` entries. It passes only if the chain reaches `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/biome-rules`, `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/biome` or a relative path to the framework's `presets/biome-rules.json` or `presets/biome-app.json`. Without the preset the SSRF, path-traversal, event-store write and admin-API plugins are missing and the step used to stay green; now it exits 1 and does not start Biome.
migration: Add `"extends": ["@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/biome"]` to the repo's `biome.json` (`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/biome-rules` for repos that keep their own file layout).

kumiko check requires uiRoots for kind "app"
detail:
`kumiko check` fails a kind "app" without uiRoots
A repo with `kind: "app"` and no `uiRoots` used to skip the UI guards silently. `kumiko check` (also with `--explain`) now prints an error and exits 1 before any step runs. Declare `uiRoots`, or set `uiRoots: []` for an app without UI; the step list then shows that the UI guards are skipped on purpose. A repo that relies on the derived manifest also gets the hint to add a `kumiko.json`. Other kinds are unchanged. `kumiko new app` now writes a `kumiko.json` with `uiRoots: ["src/features/*/web"]`.
migration:
Add `uiRoots` to the `kumiko.json` of every `kind: "app"` repo, for example `["src/app", "src/features/*/web"]`, or `[]` for an app without UI. A repo without a `kumiko.json` needs one first, since the derived manifest cannot declare uiRoots.
Workspace state at release: kumiko-platform, offlot-app, phronexsis and show-pony declare `kind: "app"` without `uiRoots`.

title: project and consumer validate the subcommand before any database work
kumiko check runs boot validation against the repo root when started from a subdirectory
kumiko check survives throwing steps, config loading validates its shape
New `kumiko check`: boot validation plus the guard suites in one command, step list derived from kumiko.json
migration: No action required — additive. A repo that today calls `kumiko-schema validate` and `kumiko-guards guards|ui|checks` separately in package.json, CI YAML or check-wt.sh replaces that chain with `bun kumiko check`; the step list then follows from kumiko.json (kind, uiRoots) instead of from the script. Private bins without a public counterpart (kumiko-guard-comment-lang, kumiko-guard-ui) stay as their own step next to it for now.
